comment: The release gate registry (scripts/release-gate.mjs); ops/release/README.md explains every field. One entry per test:* script that is a real suite; the rest are under not_in_gate with their reason. needs: none | rig | browser | rig+browser. parallelSafe: ran in a parallel lane on 2026-11-19 without disturbing another suite (never true for a rig suite). timeoutSec: measured seconds x 3 (min 120), rounded up to 30. minOk: the ok count seen on 2026-11-19 (checkin, jsA, jsB) or the count CLAUDE.md records; an ok count below it is a REGRESSION (checks disappeared); 0 = the suite prints no count or is a known failure. measured:false = no baseline yet: skipped unless --only or --include-unmeasured. quick: static or fast (about 45 s or less, no rig). triggers: globs relative to sporta-web/ ('@name' is a group); the suite's own script and globalTriggers always count; --changed errs on running more.

suites.name: icons-polish
suites.note: 1758 -> 1690 on 2026-11-19 (TOPBAR ACCOUNT 1120): the Sporta AI icon is hidden in the top bar, so the suite no longer measures it (68 checks); bring the icon back (delete [tacc-1]) and this goes back to 1758

suites.name: native
suites.note: run it ALONE: it fails different rate-limit checks when another process shares the rig's 127.0.0.1 counters (CLAUDE.md, 2026-11-18/19)

suites.name: vps-deploy
suites.note: needs dist/ (npm run release) and the rig; without dist/api/store.php it fails with "run npm run release and npm run sandbox first" (recorded in known-failures.json)

suites.name: iconset
suites.note: 7627 -> 7487 on 2026-11-19 (TOPBAR ACCOUNT 1120): the top bar's Sporta AI icon is hidden, so its 'assistant' glyph is no longer checked on every page (140 checks); bring the icon back (delete [tacc-1] of sporta-shadows.css) and this goes back to 7627

suites.name: admin-live-data
suites.note: the 2026-11-19 lane cut it at 1500 s while it was still in its mutation checks (83 checks per CLAUDE.md)

suites.name: release-gate
suites.note: the gate's own suite (fake suites in a temp config; no rig, no network)

not_in_gate.name: guest-orders
not_in_gate.reason: needs its own private database and flow; run by hand when guest checkout changes

not_in_gate.name: images-live-scan
not_in_gate.reason: covers the live images scanner, whose real run needs the live site (a Hostinger job); run by hand with the scanner

not_in_gate.reason: needs a real FTPS server (pyftpdlib); the FTPS route reaches only the old shared-hosting account
